security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Todo list, Pomodoro timer, foreground-app tracking and focus analytics for Windows
bundle.longDescription: SentryNeko combines a todo list, a Pomodoro timer, foreground application tracking and focus analytics in a single Windows desktop app. All data is stored locally in SQLite.
